notes: Sourced from DiGiCo's official DQ-Rack Datasheet PDF (digico.biz), which includes an explicit "Connections" list and A&E spec text. Confirmed I/O: 48 x XLR mic inputs, 20 x XLR line outputs, 4 x XLR switchable AES/Line outputs (2 stereo AES pairs, up to 8 AES channels), 2 x Dante EtherCON ports (labeled Primary/Secondary), 1 x USB 2.0 Type B, and 2 redundant PSUs. Datasheet does not state Dante EtherCON link speed (100Mb vs Gigabit), so grade was omitted per instructions rather than guessed. The rear-panel line drawing shows two square IEC-style power inlet modules with rocker switches for the redundant PSUs; exact IEC sub-variant (C13/C14) is not labeled in text, only inferred visually from the technical drawing, so this is the one moderately-inferred detail. 48 identical mic inputs and 20 identical line outputs were collapsed into single grouped port entries (e.g. "Mic In 1-48") since the schema has no quantity field — exact counts are given in each entry's name/note. Also has a TFT LCD menu screen and 4 menu buttons on the rear panel (system status/config, not signal/power connectors, so omitted from ports). Internal oscillator, no external word-clock/BNC sync port found on rear panel. Product code per datasheet: X-DQ-RACK. Dimensions 482.7 x 253 x 265.9 mm, weight 11 kg.

ports.name: Mic In 1-48
ports.note: 48 x female XLR mic/line inputs with remote-controlled Gain Tracking preamps.

ports.name: Line Out 1-20
ports.note: 20 x male XLR fixed analogue line outputs.

ports.name: Out 21-24 (AES/Line)
ports.note: 4 x male XLR outputs, switchable per stereo pair between analogue line level and AES3 digital (rear panel labels AES 1-2 and AES 3-4); up to 8 AES/EBU channels total across the 2 pairs.

ports.name: Dante Primary
ports.note: Primary Dante network port. Link speed (100M/Gigabit) not stated in the datasheet, so grade omitted.

ports.name: Dante Secondary
ports.note: Secondary/redundant Dante network port, used for redundant Dante or for a second stream at 96kHz.

ports.name: AC Mains Input 1
ports.note: One of two redundant PSU inlets (rear panel shows two IEC-style inlet modules with individual switches). Combined rating 100-240V~, 50-60Hz, 2.0A.

ports.name: AC Mains Input 2
ports.note: Second redundant PSU inlet, mirrors AC Mains Input 1.
